The '''AA20 Marksman bipod''' was a model of weapon [[bipod]] which was produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The bipod cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and could be applied to [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]], [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]], stabilizing the weapons if used.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The AA20 Marksman bipod was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
